title: Hinovel
body: I have never written a review before but honestly I was very disappointed and wanted to warn others. Did not like the app at all. Very expensive to be actually able to read the stories, which are alright but not professional by any means from what I’ve seen. Think of it as this spending 30+ dollars at a time to read a couple of chapters for a way steeper price then it would of been to just buy a book. For example, I payed for a subscription at the beginning which involves a 2000 coin initial (which runs out after about 10-15 chapters- and no the chapters are not long) and gives you around 80 coins per day which is maybe enough to let you read one more if your lucky. Also, very little opportunity to earn credits (what you use to read) yourself. Offers 10 ads at a time with cooldown, so 1 ad per few minutes, when it doesn’t give you the reward half the time and also has a 5 free spin chances a day. Just to mention these adds only give you about 10 credits if your lucky enough for it to register. This means if you watch all 10 ads, you only get to read about 1 chapter which I would estimate is like 3 pages each. The spin chances are not worth it(Rigged to basically where you can only get 5 to 7 credits -considering I’ve used it a multitude of times) and you also have to watch multiple adds to even spin the wheel. If you want to “double” the winnings of that wheel you have to watch more ads usually 2, for a measly reward. An example is getting a 5 credit spin after watching 2 ads and having to watch 2 more to make it 10 credits. This doesn’t amount to much at all considering unlocking the chapters takes 90-130 credits on average. Not happy at all with this performance so I canceled my subscription, and wanted to warn anyone that this app was a waste of money and time.

title: Getting too costly for the quality of writing
body: I started reading a book, My Killing President. I was very intrigued as it seemed interesting. After about 25 chapters you needed to read using coins. You earn coins daily by logging in but the amount you c an earn daily is not enough to read more than a chapter a day. This book has 652 chapters. I caved at some point and purchased some coins. The prices of the coins seemed reasonable, but as the chapters progressed they acquired more and more coins. A few chapters were 48-50 coins for 30 pages. That is way too much for a book that would cost no more than $20 in a book store. I really hope the creators of the app consider giving the reader more opportunities to earn free coins. Instead of daily their should be some hourly rewards. Otherwise at this rate I’ll finish the book in over 2 years - sounds insane but do the math. Also I think the books need to be reviewed before being put on the app. Although I am enjoying the book, I must admit that there are parts that I need to reread because it seems as if it was written in another language and then google translated it to English. I think there are way too many typos and insensitive language that should be reviewed first. Hence why I can’t bring myself to purchase more coins for writing that needs more work. I think the book has potential but it is not edited at all. In order to keep readers there needs to be more ways to acquire free coins or lower the price of the coins tremendously. Even the membership rate is too much and offers far too little coins. Think about the ratio of coins per chapter and look at what the membership offers. You’d still be reading a few chapters a week. This has potential but the coins and lack of editing is why I have it 2 stars.

title: Good app
body: Great content and a pretty good app but, I do tho think (to be honest though), that all these apps are basically just a money pit.. But, this one app, is one of my favs of them all, due to the best content I think so far.. and a wheel you can spin 5-7 times so you can win coins.. Tho tbh it lands on 5cents nearly every darn spin! (So it seems to be set nearly continuously, to land on 5 every darn time-which is NOT cool…) Ok, now for the major cons… The app should only advertise completely FINISHED BOOKS/STORIES for us to pay for and read!!! And should not advertise an UNCOMPLETED story or book - As they are basically tricking you into getting into an uncompleted story! Letting you invest all your time and money in something that isn’t even done yet!! & that may NEVER BE DONE, EVER!!! — So then you are stuck waiting many MANY MORE MONTHS (not days!!!) just for the author to submit more content to finish it!(& you wait & wait and wait and it’s not even completed still!!!/Yet!!! Honestly, in my opinion it truly seems like some of these books are just extended over and over and continued further and further on, ONLY TO keep people paying more AND MORE MONEY AND NOT BCUZ IT BENEFITS THE BOOKS AT ALL! This is definitely not always, but seems to be the case on some of these though… and is just my opinion. but I really don’t think I’m the only one who thinks this.. So for example the book I am interested in w a really talented author, that I have been reading is called “When They Touch Me” and I have ALRDY spent over 50.00 bucks on just this one book and it’s still not finished yet… The updates are maybe 2/3 times a wk lately), and with between 3 chapters to like 8 I think? updated at once…. Now, The book is great in my opinion, but as a speed reader this is just torture, to HAVE to wait so long amd have spent so much all on a unfinished book!!! And it makes me enraged!!! And this price is just super expensive too! I wouldn’t ever have spent that much money in a book store on one book, ever!!! So tbh, once this book is done (ifffff it’s EVER done!!), then I’m deleting this app PRONTO! So, like I said, this app and alllllll the app’s like this are truly just money pits in my opinion.

title: Hinovel
body: I’m continuously installing and deleting apps, but this app has remained for a long time for several reasons. Their bonuses are worth collecting and don’t expire. Their charges for chapters are reasonable (over 55 is unwarranted in my opinion and bonuses of 1,3,5 waste of time). There are a good mix of books, with super long books over 1200 chapters ( not for me) and under 900 chapters . The stories are entertaining and the authors try not to have cliffhangers or repeat storylines. So in conclusion, if there are significant changes to these then I may have to delete.
